name: Agent Warden A365 Observability
description: OpenClaw plugin that emits Agent 365 Observability SDK spans (InvokeAgent, ExecuteTool, Inference) to the M365 security stack for unified agent governance via Defender, Purview DSPM, and Admin Center.

agentId.description: Agentic app instance ID (from Agent Blueprint provisioning)

agentName.description: Display name for the agent in M365 Admin Center

agentBlueprintId.description: Entra application ID of the Agent Blueprint

agenticUserId.description: Agentic user Object ID in Entra

aaInstanceId.description: Autonomous Agent Instance ID (AA_INSTANCE_ID) — required for T1/T2/FIC token flow

channelName.description: Default channel name (telegram, api, teams, etc.)

enableA365Exporter.description: true = export to agent365.svc.cloud.microsoft, false = console exporter only

serviceName.description: OTel service name for resource attributes

serviceNamespace.description: OTel service namespace for resource attributes
